einzeiler: Discussion and review of the three books featured in the summer book club.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss their summer book club selections, reviewing each novel in detail. They share their ratings, favorite parts, and listener feedback for all three books. Finally, they announce upcoming polls for the fall book club selection.

clips.hook: A magic eight ball for ashes
clips.text: A humorous observation is made about how poetic and unusual it is to place human ashes inside a magic eight ball.

clips.hook: Comparing the plot twist to an SNL skit
clips.text: A listener compares an over-the-top plot reveal to a comedy sketch because it felt impossible to take seriously.
The hosts debate whether they could ever forgive a partner for hiding a major secret profession.

beschreibung:
It’s time for our Summer Book Club! This time around, your hosts each picked a romance to read and brought them to the podcast to discuss, rate, and inevitably debate. They are talking Our Perfect Storm by Carley Fortune, The Someday Garden by Ashley Poston, and The Romance Revival by Christina Lauren.
Tune in for their ratings, favorite (and least favorite!) moments, character thoughts, fan casts, and, of course, the all-important question: which book boyfriend reigns supreme? We’re also revealing which book was our overall favorite, which one surprised us, and whether any of these romances earned a spot on our favorites shelf.
